row.answer: Mini Gnar has extra movement speed and attack range and builds Rage by dealing or receiving damage. At full Rage, casting an ability transforms him into Mega Gnar; he also transforms automatically after a delay. Mega gains health, attack damage, armor and magic resistance, then eventually returns to Mini and temporarily cannot build Rage. Ability cooldowns are shared across forms.
row.counterplay: Watch his Rage before committing; a transformation can turn an approach into a Mega engage.
